_comment: SIDM2's own reported port status per player, keyed by THIS project's card id.
WHY THIS FILE IS HAND-MAINTAINED. Everything else in the SIDM2 worklist table
(file counts, edge degree, open TODO counts, card status) is derived from local
data by scripts/dev/gen-sidm2-worklist.js. These accuracy figures are not --
they come from the SIDM2 project's own reporting and this project does not
re-derive them. Keeping them in a data file rather than inline in the doc is what
lets the rest of the table regenerate without a human retyping SIDM2's numbers.
Update this file when SIDM2 reports new results, then re-run:
done     - ported, SIDM2 reports it working at the quoted fidelity
partial  - ported but explicitly incomplete or below par (shows as a warning)
variant  - resolved as a variant inside another player's path, not a separate port
unlisted - this project's card cites SIDM2 as provenance but SIDM2's own port
list does not name it; needs reconciling, do not assume either way
`note` is quoted as close to SIDM2's own wording as fits a table cell.
source: SIDM2 project port-status tables (default drivers + native-driver/bin ports), supplied 2026-07-25
